notes: Same-spelling homonym risk: H166 אָהַל ("to be clear; shine") shares these exact consonants and vowels but is a separate, unrelated Strong's entry, not yet in this dataset. If it's ever added, both roots will need the superscript convention (אהל¹/אהל²) -- flagging now the way H7034's notes flagged the קלה¹/קלה² collision before it happened.

Trimmed "move/pitch a tent" to "pitch a tent" per the tightened compound-gloss standard: both citations (Gen.13.12, 13.18) show pitching a tent specifically; "move" is implied context, not an independently-shown distinct action.
